summary: Copel (Companhia Paranaense de Energia) filed a Form 6-K containing minutes of its Board meeting approving a declaration of Interest on Equity (JCP) of R$706 million from retained earnings, payable September 30, 2026. Record date is April 29, 2026, with ex-dividend date April 30, 2026. The amount is net of withholding tax and allocated to the mandatory 2026 dividend per Bylaws. Board approved unanimously after executive recommendation. This is a routine capital return, not a special situation.
